S3 implemented in isolated codex-ledger-manifest, stacked from preserved gated S1 163dc3b. Pinned UI-C98a781c integrated once as6e763f95a0100b2bf4f818cbcef598712502e0c2. The schema-list merge retained both additions; generated API inventory/evidence retained the S1 baseline, explicitly stale pending final re-record, never hand-merged. Shared codec-file coexistence with UI-E S4 settled Fray36 @313-317; no cross-candidate import.

Additive manifest@1: SourceFile stores raw binary bytes, no packed layout/semantic identity, schema names existing parser definition. ImportSpec role stores primary or inventory description. LedgerSource(ledger,sourceFile,importSpec,Primary|TrialInventory) checks endpoint roles, multiplicity and declared parser/options/inventory bindings; resolver exposes strict UTF-8 text and decoded descriptions, without replay evidence. Registered primary decoder forwards through Delegating. ManifestReverification in io follows sources plus LedgerOf and invokes existing synchronous verifier; source-less/missing bindings refuse. New errors SourceBinding and ManifestBinding have catalog/sample/docs coverage. Old fixture files unchanged. No bounded-execution or authenticity claim.

Strict rootJVM/rootJS Test/compile under GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, headerCheckAll, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, checkBoundaries. Covers all manifest suites, schema compatibility, diagnostic catalogs/docs, new replay/forgery/inventory tests, artifact loading/root checks and published manifest law suite.
